HomePage.title: Nextjs GraphQL Quickstart
HomePage.description: Next.js GraphQL Quickstart is a modern, full-stack web application template designed to help you get started quickly with Next.js, GraphQL, Prisma, Apollo Client, and Redux Toolkit. This project offers a powerful, scalable foundation for building dynamic and performant web applications using the latest technologies.
